komando.note: three chevrons rebuilt from centre lines on the grid: stroke 9, pitch 17, run 17, rise 15 each side (was 78/165/165/150 in a 768 box); round caps and joins kept; true symmetry top to bottom

trady.note: 349 polygon nodes to 92 curve/line segments (2 fitted, 3 true circles, 2 stroked, 7 mirrored); scale 0.0759

toolips.note: constructed: regular hexagon, point up, centre 32, 33.0, circumradius 27.75 (flats x 8.0 to 56.0), all six corners radius 5; wrench head circle centre 32, 31 radius 13; handle slot 9 wide (x 27.5 to 36.5), straight parallel walls to the bottom edge; jaw = one capsule of radius 4.9 ending at 32.3, 27.5, leaning 17.7 degrees, two parallel straight cuts to the head circle. The traced original had the slot 2.2 left of centre and a wider, non-regular hexagon (48.4 by 52)

cuwan.note: constructed, symmetric about x 32: head x 12 to 52, y 21.5 to 54.5, top corners 15, bottom corners 11; face plate hole x 16 to 48, y 30 to 49, corners 8; antenna stem 3 wide (x 30.5 to 33.5) from y 17; ball circle centre 32, 14 radius 4.5; ears x 6 to 11.5 and 52.5 to 58, y 32.5 to 46.5, outer corners 3.5, inner 1; eyes: two identical half-circle arcs, centre x 25 and 39, y 40.5, radius 3.5, stroke 2.5, round caps. The ear gap (0.5) is below the minimum gap of 3, as in the original: at 20 px the ears join the head

kongkow.note: constructed: mouth bar 6 by 48 at x 51.5 (stadium, radius 3); bell a trapezoid, left edge x 24 from y 21.5 to 38.5, right edge x 49.5 from y 11 to 49 (straight edges, radii 1.5 left and 1 right); grip x 6 to 21, y 21.5 to 38.5, left corners radius 6, right corners square; handle 8.5 wide, top y 41.5, bottom y 58, sides parallel at slope 0.3, bottom corners radius 3.5; gaps 3 (grip to bell) and 3 (grip to handle)

meridian.note: three identical leaning bars: height 28, lean 14 (slope 0.5), thickness 11, pitch 18, corner cut 2; all three bars are now the same shape to the decimal

glamor.note: the owner's drawing at its own proportions (base 24 by 22, collar 20 by 7, bullet 16 wide, tip slope 0.5), sheared at slope 0.5, one scale of 1.054 into the 50 by 58 box, vertices snapped to half units; corner cuts 3 (base), 2 (collar), 3 (bullet)

design-tokens.note: four cells of 24 with a gap of 4 (was 24 with a gap of 2, too tight for 20 px): circle d24, square r4, pill 24 by 12, leaning bar at slope 0.5; strokes turned into one filled shape
